in_sanskrit.name: यश्राज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings prosperity and rules over it

in_hindi.name: यश्राज
in_hindi.meaning: यश् (yash) = शक्ति (shakti) = power, rāज (raj) = राजा (raja) = king
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who possesses great power and rules over it

in_tamil.name: யாஷ்ராஜ்
in_tamil.meaning: யாஷ் (yash) = உதவி (udhavi) = prosperity, ராஜ் (raj) = அரசன் (arasan) = king
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who brings prosperity and rules over it

in_telugu.name: యశ్రాజ్
in_telugu.meaning: యశ్ (yash) = శక్తి (shakti) = power, రాజ్ (raj) = రాజోపద్యయ (rajo-padhyaya) = king
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who possesses great power and rules over it

in_marathi.name: Yashraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of success
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yashraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Yashraj is derived from two Sanskrit words - Yash (meaning success, victory, fame) and Raj (meaning king, ruler, power). The name signifies a powerful leader who has achieved success and victory in life.

The name signifies a powerful leader who has achieved success and victory in life.
